identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a cinematic, mission-critical operating console that feels like a sovereign system, not a SaaS dashboard.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Aerospace Cockpits with Financial Terminals.
Emotion First: The user should feel 'In Command' and 'Safe'.
Content is King: Data is the hero. No decoration without function.
Zoom In: Focus on the execution pipeline details.
Negative Space: Use void-like darkness to frame the data.

color_palette.description: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Refined). Deep Obsidian Void with Precision Blue highlights and Industrial Amber for active states.

accent.description: Use for 'Processing', 'Running', or 'Caution' states. The 'Industrial' connector.

rules: Headings (h1-h3): Tracking-tight (-0.02em), Font-weight 500 or 600. No bold.
Labels/Overlines: Uppercase, Tracking-widest (0.1em), Font-size 10-11px, Font-weight 600, Mono font preferred.
Data/Numbers: ALWAYS use JetBrains Mono. Tabular nums if possible.
Screenfit: Critical dashboards must fit 1080p without scrolling if possible.
No Overlap: Panels must never overlap. Use strict grid cells.
Reflow: On mobile, stack vertically but maintain density.

glassmorphism.css: background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

animation.philosophy: Meaningful State Changes Only. No idle motion.
animation.topology: Slow, pulsing flows (2s-4s duration) to indicate active data movement.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium border border-border

inputs.base: bg-black/20 border border-border focus:border-primary rounded-md px-3 py-2 font-mono text-sm

topology_graph.style: Custom dark theme. Nodes: Minimal rectangles with status dots. Edges: Animated SVG paths (Bezier).
topology_graph.interaction: Zoomable, pannable, clickable nodes for drill-down.

libraries.charts: Recharts (customized for dark mode, no grid lines, minimal axes)
libraries.topology: React Flow (preferred) or React Force Graph
libraries.motion: Framer Motion (AnimatePresence for page transitions, layout prop for grid reflow)

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid deep colors or subtle noise.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for numbers. Use 'JetBrains Mono'.
DO NOT center text in dashboards. Left align for readability.
Ensure all text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
Use 'gap-4' minimum for layouts to prevent clutter.
Images/Icons must not be playful. No emojis.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a serious, mission-critical console. Ignore standard SaaS trends. Think 'SpaceX Control Room' or 'Bloomberg Terminal'. Implement the 'Task Runner' with a 3-column layout: Input (Left), Topology/Pipeline (Center), Output/Logs (Right). Use the 'Electric Amber' accent sparingly for 'Running' states to create a sense of active machinery.
